games.name: [Alpha]Grand Master
games.desc:
In the aftermath of the Dimensional War, the cosmos lay in ruins.
Worlds burned. Civilizations fell.

When the silence came, only one remained:
Zantien, the Heaven-Cleaving Blade Master.

With power beyond time and a will unshaken,
he ended the war and united all realms under one rule.

Ten thousand years passed.

Then, the Zantien vanished.
The Throne of Fate remained unclaimed.

Chaos erupted across realms and dimensions
as countless challengers rose to seize it.

To end the war, a single path was forged —
one trial above all others.

Thus began the Grand Master Trials.

Only one shall rise.
Only one shall rule.
Only one shall become the True Grand Master!
